page_title: EnviousWispr: Free Private AI Dictation for macOS

sources.entry: EnviousWispr - Sub-second dictation running Whisper/Parakeet locally with privacy-first AI text polish. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: EnviousWispr
summary.one_liner: A free, private AI dictation app for macOS (with an Android version mentioned) that turns speech into polished text in whatever app you are using, with on-device transcription and optional local or cloud AI polish.
use_cases: Dictating emails and messages on a Mac
Turning rough spoken notes into clean text
Hands-free writing when typing is uncomfortable
Drafting essays or show notes by voice
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a five-stage pipeline: audio trimming of silence, local speech-to-text, custom vocabulary and formatting (snippets, custom words, fillers, emoji and numbers), AI polish, and direct text insertion into the active app with clipboard fallback. It offers two on-device speech engines: Parakeet (the default, for fast everyday English-focused dictation) and Whisper Large v3 Turbo (about 886 MB on demand, 99+ languages). For polish, it lists local options (Apple Intelligence, the EG-1 and S1-mini models, or a local Ollama model) and cloud options via the user's own API key (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or hosted Ollama). The page says requests go directly to the chosen provider with no EnviousWispr markup or subscription.
notable: Speech runs on-device on Apple Silicon; audio stays on the Mac, and local polish keeps text there too
Bring-your-own-key cloud polish with requests sent directly to the provider, no token markup
Choice of Parakeet (fast default) or Whisper (broader languages) speech engines
caveats: Mac requires macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon (M1 or later); Android requires Android 13+ and 6 GB memory
Cloud polish uses your own provider API key, and provider charges may apply
Apple Intelligence polish requires macOS 26+ and Apple Intelligence availability; some advanced formatting requires macOS 27 with M3 or newer and 12GB memory
